name: Nomod for WooCommerce
author: Nomod

sections.description:
Nomod for WooCommerce is built for businesses in the UAE and KSA, offering a smooth and efficient way to process payments. With support for major credit and debit cards, Apple Pay, Google Pay, Tabby, Tamara, and Mada, your customers enjoy a fast and secure checkout experience—leading to higher conversions and a smoother shopping journey.

With same-day payouts and an easy setup process, Nomod is the ideal payment solution for businesses looking to streamline payments. Trusted by over 18,000 businesses across the UAE and KSA, Nomod provides a secure and reliable way to accept payments online. Plus, with support for over 135 currencies worldwide, you can accept payments from international customers effortlessly.

Why Use Nomod for WooCommerce

  • Same-day payouts – Get access to your funds faster than most payment providers.
  • More ways to pay – Accept all major card networks, Apple Pay, Google Pay, Visa, Mastercard, Mada, Tabby, Tamara, and more.
  • Multi-currency – Accept payments in 135+ currencies with automatic conversion.
  • Buy Now, Pay Later support – Give your customers the flexibility to split their payments into up to 6 interest-free installments with Tabby and Tamara.
  • Amazing support – Get quick assistance whenever you need it.
  • No contracts or monthly fees – Enjoy payment flexibility with no long-term obligations.
  • Simple, transparent pricing – No setup fees, no hidden charges, just clear and straightforward costs.
  • Full and partial refunds – Easily manage refunds directly in Nomod for a smooth and hassle-free process.

Accepted Payment Methods

Cards
– Visa
– Mastercard
– Amex
– Mada
– JCB
– Diners
– Discover

Digital Wallets
– Apple Pay
– Google Pay
– Samsung Pay

Buy Now, Pay Later
– Tabby
– Tamara

How to Get Started

  1. Sign up with Nomod – Create your Nomod account in the Nomod App and complete your account verification to start accepting payments.
  2. Install and activate the Nomod for WooCommerce plugin – In your WordPress admin dashboard, go to Plugins > Add New, search for “Nomod for WooCommerce,” click Install Now, and then Activate.
  3. Generate and copy your Nomod API Key – Navigate to Settings > Business > Connect apps and manage keys in the Nomod App.
  4. Configure the Nomod plugin in WooCommerce – In your WordPress dashboard, go to WooCommerce > Settings, click on the Payments tab, and select Nomod from the list of payment methods. Click Manage, enable the payment method, and paste your API Key into the designated field.
  5. Save changes and start accepting payments – Click Save changes to complete the setup. Nomod will now be a payment option for your customers at checkout.
sections.faq:
Which countries do you support?

Nomod is currently available for businesses in the United Arab Emirates and the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. Stay tuned for future expansions!

Which payment methods are supported?

Nomod supports all major credit and debit cards, along with Apple Pay, Google Pay, and Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) options like Tabby and Tamara. This allows your customers to split their payments into up to 6 interest-free installments.

Can I accept international payments?

Yes! With Nomod, you can accept payments in over 135 currencies, allowing you to reach international customers effortlessly. Payments are processed securely, and you receive settlements in your local currency.

When do I get paid out?

Nomod offers flexible payout options to suit your business needs. You can choose from same-day, two-day, or weekly payouts. Same-day payouts are an exclusive benefit for businesses subscribed to the Membership feature, ensuring even faster access to your funds. Payouts are automatically transferred to your bank account, helping you maintain a steady cash flow.

How do Nomod’s payment processing fees work?

Nomod offers transparent and competitive pricing for payment processing. To view the latest fees and pricing details, please visit our Pricing page.

How do I get support?

If you need further assistance, feel free to reach out to us, and our team will be happy to assist you.
